article.title: AI Inspo串接社群趨勢、內容生成與表現回顧
article.title_en: AI Inspo connects social trends, creation and performance review
article.summary: AI Inspo推出社群AI代理，把帳戶分析、趨勢探索、內容製作及發布放進同一工作流程。
article.summary_en: AI Inspo launched a social agent connecting account analysis, trend discovery, content production and publishing.
highlights: 代理按帳戶目標及發展階段提出內容方向。
使用者可選擇參考格式並加入自己的主題，再以發布表現修訂下一份簡報。
highlights_en: Recommendations reflect account goals and development stage.
Users add their topic to a reference format, then use publication results to inform the next brief.
article.why: 社群團隊可把趨勢選題與下一輪內容規劃連結，決定哪些格式值得延續，哪些需要調整主題或結構。
article.why_en: Social teams can decide which formats to repeat and which topics or structures need revision.
article.next_step: 用同一個品牌主題建立兩種參考格式，記錄生成稿與發布後的觀察，再決定下一份內容簡報要改哪一項。
article.next_step_en: Develop two reference formats for one brand topic and retain drafts and post-publication observations before changing the next brief.
article.detail: 公司把社群策略與創意內容列為兩項核心能力，代理會參照帳戶的過往工作及目標調整建議。團隊可以保留每次選題的理由、使用的參考格式與後續觀察，讓下一輪規劃有具體依據。趨勢格式只是創作起點，實際內容是否適合品牌仍需逐篇審閱，不能由參考帖的表現推定新帖成效。
article.detail_en: The company identifies strategy and creative production as its two core capabilities. Retain the topic rationale, reference format and later observations for each iteration. A trending format is a starting point; its prior performance does not establish results for a new post.
